visual_qa.summary: The Power BI report migration failed QA validation. Critical defects include missing 'Sales by Region' (Pie) and 'Sales Trend' (Line) charts replaced by a 'Visual Missing' placeholder box, which also partially obscures the 'Sales Details' table. Additionally, the report title was modified from 'Sales Overview' to 'Sales Performance'.

critical_findings.issue: Missing visuals and visual occlusion due to dataset/rendering binding failure
critical_findings.reason: The 'Sales by Region' (Pie) and 'Sales Trend' (Line) charts fail to render, replaced by a 'Visual Missing' placeholder box that obscures the left half of the 'Sales Details' table. As noted in Migration Rule rule-003 and past case-102, this is characteristic of a broken data source or table binding failure rather than intentional removal.

critical_findings.issue: Data row count mismatch and record discrepancies
critical_findings.reason: Power BI contains 990 rows vs. Spotfire's 1000 rows, with 15 missing row IDs (100010–100024) and 5 extra row IDs (200001–200005), indicating a flawed ETL/data import query or incorrect filtering.

critical_findings.issue: Data value mismatches in core financial metrics (Sales & Profit)
critical_findings.reason: 30 total value mismatches exist across Sales (20) and Profit (10). Similar to past case-101, where an added text overlay showed 'Sales $2.51M' due to an unfiltered/duplicated dataset, dataset integrity must be rectified.

critical_findings.issue: Unauthorized report title modification and overlay text box
critical_findings.reason: Report title was altered from 'Sales Overview' to 'Sales Performance', and an unnecessary text overlay ('Sales $2.51M') was introduced.

priority_actions.action: Rebind missing visuals to the correct Power BI dataset tables and restore layout
priority_actions.reason: Following rule-003 and case-102, resolve the broken table bindings for the Pie and Line charts to remove the 'Visual Missing' box and unobscure the detail table.

priority_actions.action: Reconcile data source queries to fix row discrepancies and value mismatches
priority_actions.reason: Investigate missing rows (IDs 100010–100024), extra rows (200001–200005), and Sales/Profit calculations (similar to case-101 filter/duplication issues).

priority_actions.action: Restore original report title and remove unapproved banner overlays
priority_actions.reason: Align report header text to baseline ('Sales Overview') to maintain visual compliance.

analysis.management_summary: The Power BI migration for the Sales Overview report has failed QA validation due to critical data and visual defects. Significant data mismatches exist, including missing/extra records and 30 metric value discrepancies in Sales and Profit. Visually, two primary charts are broken due to binding failures, creating layout corruption that obscures the detail table. Deployment is blocked until data pipeline and visual bindings are corrected.
analysis.developer_summary: Fix data source queries causing the row discrepancy (Spotfire 1000 rows vs Power BI 990 rows; missing IDs 100010–100024, extra IDs 200001–200005) and resolve 30 value mismatches in Sales and Profit fields (reference case-101 for potential dataset filtering issues). Rebind the 'Sales by Region' (Pie) and 'Sales Trend' (Line) visuals to the correct dataset tables to clear the 'Visual Missing' placeholder (per rule-003 and case-102) and reveal the obscured 'Sales Details' table columns. Finally, reset title to 'Sales Overview' and remove the '$2.51M' overlay box.
analysis.next_qa_action: Reject current build, assign remediation tickets to the development team, and perform a full Data & Visual re-validation upon delivery of the corrected Power BI report.
